digest.description: Lowercase sha256 digest with sha256: prefix (same form as guide asset content_hash).

path_digest.description: A path paired with its content digest.

path.description: Repo-relative path for reading-list entries; guide-relative path for artifacts and outputs.

step_inputs.description: Declared fingerprint material for one pipeline step. input_digest is the canonical hash of a normalized serialization of this object.

artifacts.description: Upstream guide artifacts this step consumed, with stable content digests. Guide-relative paths.

model.description: Resolved model id used for this step (not a slot alias like sonnet).

params.description: Stable assignment fields. Never include observed_at or run timestamps.

dimension.description: Review dimension id; required for review.* steps only.

notes.description: Operator notes for this guide; empty string when none.

persona.description: Persona id; required for draft and review.* steps.

provider.description: Provider display name from the workflow assignment.

prompt_digest.description: Digest of the prompt template with volatile assignment fields removed.

reading_list.description: Doctrine and persona files this step reads, in order. Repo-relative paths.

step_record.description: One pipeline step's input fingerprint and output digests after a successful run.

completed_at.description: UTC time when this step record was written.

input_digest.description: Canonical hash of the normalized inputs object.

outputs.description: Guide-relative artifacts this step produced or affirmed, with stable content digests.

steps.description: Step records keyed by fixed step id. research is always executed (record only); draft and review.* are skippable when predicates pass.

description: Per-guide pipeline lockfile (guides/<slug>/pipeline.lock.json), schema_version 1. Records input fingerprints so draft and per-dimension review can be skipped when inputs are unchanged. Normative semantics: doctrine/pipeline-lock.md.

persona.description: Persona id used when step entries were written.

runtime.description: Observational runtime label (e.g. pi). Not part of skip digests.

slug.description: Stable Guide identity; must match the guide directory name.

updated_at.description: UTC time when this lockfile was last rewritten.

title: PipelineLock
